title: Move-Out Accounting Note: Move-Out Cleaning Water Allowance by Household Size
content:
# Move-Out Cleaning Allowance — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Note.** In the final period of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account, a move-out cleaning allowance is subtracted from the water usage together with the final water allowance before the final water overage is measured:

| Approved occupants on the Apartment Home Lease | Move-out cleaning allowance |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.750 thousand gallons |
| exactly 3 | 0.500 thousand gallons |
| 1 or 2 | none (0) |

The final water overage is then the service end water usage less the final water allowance and less the cleaning allowance, never below zero, rounded to 3 decimals.

**Record read.** The approved occupants count on the lease.

## Cases (hypothetical service end read 4.750, final water allowance 3.000)

- Five approved occupants: 4.750 less 3.000 less 0.750 is 1.000.
- Three approved occupants: 1.250.
- Two approved occupants: 1.750.
- Four approved occupants with a service end read of 3.500: 3.500 less 3.000 less 0.750 is below zero, so 0.
